NAVM.name: Navmesh
NAVM.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas NAVM record; header flags 11 Initially Disabled, 26 AutoGen (xEdit wbDefinitionsCommon.pas flags). NVGD is omitted: its per-grid-square u16 count prefix is a count-prefixed array, which fnv.schema/1 cannot express.

DATA.name: Data
DATA.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas NAVM wbStruct(DATA): FormID Cell then five u32 counts. The counts are what the array subrecords are sized from (SetCountPathOnValue), which fnv.schema/1 cannot reference, so the arrays below fill to the end of the subrecord instead.

NVCA.name: Cover Triangles
NVCA.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas NAVM wbArray(NVCA, 'Cover Triangles', itU16) with count from DATA\Cover Triangle Count. Fill-to-end.

NVDP.name: Door Links
NVDP.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas NAVM wbArrayS(NVDP, 'Door Links', wbStructSK([1,0])): door REFR FormID, triangle u16, 2 unused bytes. Fill-to-end; count from DATA\Door Link Count.

NVEX.name: Edge Links
NVEX.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas NAVM wbArray(NVEX): u32 type (wbNavmeshEdgeLinkEnum), navmesh NAVM FormID, triangle u16. Fill-to-end; count from DATA\Edge Link Count.

NVGD.name: Navmesh Grid
NVGD.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas NAVM wbStruct(NVGD, 'Navmesh Grid'): u32 Divisor, f32 Max X/Y Distance, Navmesh Bounds (Vec3 Min, Vec3 Max), then Cells. Cells is a fill-to-end array of Cell, and Cell is an array of u16 triangle indices with a u16 count prefix (xEdit passes Count = -2 = arcU16), which is now expressible. Verified against real bytes: every one of the 4,771 NVGD subrecords in FalloutNV.esm parses to exactly Divisor*Divisor cells with zero bytes left over.

NVTR.name: Triangles
NVTR.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas NAVM wbArray(NVTR): 3x u16 vertex indices, 3x i16 edges (wbNVTREdgeToStr reads a value as an NVEX index exactly when the edge's link flag bit is set, -1 for none), u16 flags (wbNavmeshTriangleFlags), u16 cover flags. Fill-to-end; count from DATA\Triangle Count.

NVVX.name: Vertices
NVVX.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas NAVM wbArray(NVVX, 'Vertices', wbVec3) with count from DATA\Vertex Count. Expressed here as fill-to-end: the subrecord holds nothing but vertices, so consuming the rest of it is equivalent.
